presentation.description:
Computes the raw-material shopping list for FFXIV's daily Grand Company Supply and Provisioning missions. Reads today's 11 turn-ins (3 gatherers + 8 crafters), recursively expands each required item through the Lumina Recipe sheet down to gathered / vendor / drop leaves, and surfaces both a per-mission breakdown and a single aggregate list that calls out materials needed by multiple classes.

v0.1.2 adds a "Plan route on web" button that hands the aggregate off to a companion route-planner page.

v0.1.4 adds a "Have" column showing how many of each material are already in your bags / crystal pouch / saddlebag (HQ + NQ summed), with the same counts exported to the web page as the starting value of its editable progress column.

Populates the moment you open the Grand Company Personnel Officer's Supply / Provisioning list once per session.

Usage:
  /gcs    - open / close the main window

search.website_text:
Personal gaming-tools monorepo. Currently hosts the BulkDesynth Dalamud plugin (FFXIV). # gaming-tools

Monorepo for personal game tooling. Currently houses Dalamud (FFXIV) plugins
under [`FF14/`](./FF14). Each plugin builds and publishes independently via
GitHub Actions; the resulting `pluginmaster.json` files are served from
GitHub Pages so they can be subscribed to from inside the game client.

## Plugins

| Plugin | Path | Subscribe URL |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Bulk Desynth](./FF14/BulkDesynth) | `FF14/BulkDesynth` | `https://jdw-ss.github.io/gaming-tools/ff14/bulkdesynth/pluginmaster.json` |
| [Wondrous Tails Odds](./FF14/WondrousTailsSolver) | `FF14/WondrousTailsSolver` | `https://jdw-ss.github.io/gaming-tools/ff14/wondroustailssolver/pluginmaster.json` |
| [GC Supply Helper](./FF14/GcSupplyHelper) | `FF14/GcSupplyHelper` | `https://jdw-ss.github.io/gaming-tools/ff14/gcsupplyhelper/pluginmaster.json` |

(The subscribe URL works once the GitHub Pages site has been enabled on
this repository and the build workflow has run at least once — see
[Deployment](#deployment) below.)

## Layout

```
.
├── .github/workflows/
│   ├── build-bulkdesynth.yml          CI: build + publish BulkDesynth on push
│   ├── build-wondroustailssolver.yml  CI: build + publish WondrousTailsOdds on push
│   └── build-gcsupplyhelper.yml       CI: build + publish GcSupplyHelper on push
├── docs/                              Output: served by GitHub Pages
│   ├── ff14/bulkdesynth/
│   │   ├── latest.zip
│   │   └── pluginmaster.json
│   ├── ff14/wondroustailssolver/
│   │   ├── latest.zip
│   │   └── pluginmaster.json
│   └── ff14/gcsupplyhelper/
│       ├── latest.zip
│       └── pluginmaster.json
└── FF14/
    ├── BulkDesynth/                   Source for the BulkDesynth plugin
    ├── WondrousTailsSolver/           Source for the WondrousTailsOdds plugin
    └── GcSupplyHelper/                Source for the GcSupplyHelper plugin
```

The `docs/` folder is the GitHub Pages root. Each plugin gets a dedicated
subpath so future plugins (e.g. `FF14/SomethingElse`) drop in without
disturbing existing subscribers.

## Deployment

1. Push the repo to GitHub (`gh repo create jdw-ss/gaming-tools --public --source=. --remote=origin`).
2. On the repository's **Settings → Pages**, set:
   - Source: *Deploy from a branch*
   - Branch: `main` / folder: `/docs`
3. Push any change under `FF14/BulkDesynth/**` (or trigger the workflow
   manually). CI will build, zip, refresh `pluginmaster.json`, and commit
   the new artifacts into `docs/ff14/bulkdesynth/` on `main`.
4. In-game: Dalamud → Settings → Experimental → **Custom Plugin
   Repositories** → paste the subscribe URL from the table above → Save.

The first build can take a couple of minutes (Pages needs to publish);
subsequent updates are picked up by Dalamud the next time it refreshes
the repo (or click the refresh icon on the row).

## Per-plugin docs

See each plugin's own README for usage / commands / safety model:

- [`FF14/BulkDesynth/README.md`](./FF14/BulkDesynth/README.md)
- [`FF14/WondrousTailsSolver/README.md`](./FF14/WondrousTailsSolver/README.md)
- [`FF14/GcSupplyHelper/README.md`](./FF14/GcSupplyHelper/README.md)
